rem-fd-frontier-status-separation.physical_scope: Dated status reporting for the mathematical regularity problem of the three-dimensional incompressible constant-density Navier–Stokes model; it makes no empirical claim about real-fluid singularities and supplies no accepted proof.

rem-fd-learned-fluid-evidence-scope.physical_scope: Methodological scope of computational and learned fluid models for specified input cases and intended uses; no performance claim is made for an unnamed model or unreported physical measurement.

ex-fd-benchmark-space-time-dimension.physical_scope: A constructed nonrelativistic Euclidean data-domain example for a family of planar velocity fields; it asserts no numerical result, experiment, or physical prediction.
